topics.title: Linear programming problems and their terms

concepts.learning_objective: Describe a linear programming problem and the meaning of the words linear and programming in it.
Identify a linear objective function Z = ax + by and its decision variables.
Recognise linear constraints and the non-negative restrictions x >= 0, y >= 0.

topics.title: Mathematical formulation of a linear programming problem

concepts.learning_objective: Translate the limits stated in a real-life problem into linear inequalities in the decision variables.
Write the linear objective function to be maximised or minimised from the data of a problem.

topics.title: Feasible region, feasible solutions and the fundamental theorems

concepts.learning_objective: Determine the feasible region, its corner points and whether a point is a feasible or an infeasible solution.
Distinguish a bounded feasible region from an unbounded one.
Apply the theorems that place optimal values of a linear objective function at corner points of the feasible region.

topics.title: Corner point method on bounded regions

concepts.learning_objective: Solve a linear programming problem with a bounded feasible region by evaluating Z at its corner points.
Recognise that when two corner points give the same optimal value, every point of the segment joining them is optimal.

topics.title: Unbounded regions and problems with no feasible solution

concepts.learning_objective: Use the open half-plane test to decide whether the smallest or largest corner value is the optimum on an unbounded region.
Recognise a system of constraints that has no feasible region and hence no feasible solution.
